description: dbt Cloud connector (read-only). Surfaces dbt Cloud jobs and their latest run status across accounts via the Administrative API v2 (`/api/v2/accounts/ → /api/v2/accounts/{id}/jobs/`, offset-paged) into the local index as `dbt:job` items (external_id `<accountId>:<jobId>`). Each job carries name, account/project/environment ids, dbt version, state (active/deleted), schedule cron, triggers, created/updated timestamps, the most-recent run status when present, and a canonical dbt Cloud job-UI URL. Authenticates with a dbt Cloud service/user API token sent as `Authorization: Token <token>` (the literal word `Token`, a space, then the raw token — not `Bearer`). Default host `https://cloud.getdbt.com`; regional / custom-access-URL instances (e.g. https://emea.dbt.com, https://au.dbt.com) override `dbt.api_base` — those non-default hosts inherit the same Task-14 runtime-merge follow-up as `sentry.url` (only the SaaS default host is in the static sandbox manifest today). Restrict to a single account via the optional `dbt.account_id` vault key; otherwise all accounts are discovered. v1 indexes jobs + run status only — model-level lineage (`data_model` items with upstream/downstream refs) requires the separate dbt Discovery GraphQL API and is a deferred follow-up. The `dbt.job.trigger` write tool is deferred to Phase 6 behind HITL.
